cropRecommendation.pageDescription: Find the most suitable crop for your farm based on soil nutrients and weather conditions.
cropRecommendation.step1Desc: Enter the nutrient values from your soil test.
cropRecommendation.step2Desc: Enter current or average weather conditions.

yieldPrediction.disclaimerText: This is an AI-based estimate calculated using historical data. The actual harvest may vary depending on unexpected weather changes, diseases, and local farm practices.

diseaseRisk.pageDescription: Check the risk level for diseases in your crop based on current weather conditions.
diseaseRisk.sectionDesc: Enter the recent weather and crop details to assess the risk of disease outbreak.

cropLifeCycle.pageDescription: Learn crop growth stages and important farming activities from seed to harvest.
cropLifeCycle.selectTitle: Select a Crop to View its Life Cycle
cropLifeCycle.selectDesc: Choose from the available crops in our database.
cropLifeCycle.advice1: Monitor soil moisture regularly and provide appropriate irrigation.
cropLifeCycle.advice2: Check plants frequently for early signs of pests and diseases.
cropLifeCycle.advice3: Maintain proper soil nutrition based on periodic soil testing.
cropLifeCycle.advice4: Keep the field clear of weeds that compete for nutrients.
cropLifeCycle.disclaimerText: Growth duration and specific stages may vary based on the local climate, soil type, and farming practices.
